about: The one line `pine service` on the other machine writes on stdout (src/remote.ts connectRemote), read by the core after SSH let it in. line is that line, without its line break; the command then holds until its stdin ends. expect is {"service": ...} with token, home ("~/.pine" when none is said), version (or null), started (false when not said), host and port (where its daemon answers); or {"error": {kind, message}}. In a message, {given} is the machine as the owner wrote it and {label} its short name.
